details:
Head and Wrist Tracking Data is not being sent over on Quest! Programs that use the OSCQuery such as SlimeVR and OSCQueryExplorer in Windows doesn't detect it, it doesn't seem to send Head and Wrist Position at all. Turning on or off does nothing. I've also heard from people that in some cases, it works but rarely. Most of the time, it's just plain broken. The OSCQueryExplorer also detects the VRChat client fine but doesn't send HMD and Hand Positions. I've also done more testing and when 'Allow Sending Head and Wrist VR Tracking OSC Data' disabled, it asks me to enable it at bottom, but when enabled, it just says that its *Sending Data to [IP ADDRESS:PORT]* but no data is being sent at all. This issue seems to have existed for a while, and I've been waiting for it to get fixed, and no one seems to have reported such issue here. I'm unaware if this issue also persists on PC.

How to replicate:

1. Open any OSC application that utilizes the Head and Wrist Data such as the OSCQueryExplorer.

2. Enable 'Allow Sending Head and Wrist VR Tracking OSC Data' in IK & Tracking.

3. Observe.

Steps I've tried to fix:

- Rebooting Router

- Restarting VRChat and Program (OSCQueryExplorer)

- Reinstalled VRChat

- Fixed my Windows Firewall Configuration

- Turning 'Allow Sending Head and Wrist VR Tracking OSC Data' off and on (surprisingly, this does not work).

- Resetting OSC Config

- Turning off and on OSC itself.
title: OSC Head and Wrist Tracking Not Working/Inconsistent
